True Colours#000.src: Meet up with The Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#001.src: Player! Did you hear? They- they finished, um, sorting through the reports!
True Colours#001.speaker: Sui

True Colours#002.src: Azael says he has news about everyone from the Roughworks!
True Colours#002.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#003.src: Indeed... indeed. Ehm... where to begin...
True Colours#003.speaker: Azael

True Colours#004.src: Outsiders, I would... temper your expectations.
True Colours#004.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#006.src: I am afraid we are sorely lacking in good news. The Owls have returned with reports of a rather sudden influx of prisoners taken to Deraj Prison following the festival.
True Colours#006.speaker: Azael

True Colours#008.src: No... no, no, it- it can't be, there- there has to be another explanation...
True Colours#008.speaker: Sui

True Colours#009.src: Ah, Gravity's Monolith... it truly is a sight to behold, dark carved stone and burning crimson lights shining deep in the southern wastes...
True Colours#009.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#010.src: A shame it's inescapable, or I'd love to pay a visit. It's true, what they say- there is no escaping its pull once it gets a hold of you!
True Colours#010.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#011.src: I... I've, I've heard the rumors... are- are they really true?
True Colours#011.speaker: Sui

True Colours#012.src: As far as we can tell. We don't have a single record of a successful escape attempt. Supposedly, the Warden's blessing keeps the prisoners in line.
True Colours#012.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#014.src: Cileon, goodness! There's no need for the dramatics! What they mean to say, dear friends, is that none who enter are ever heard from again!
True Colours#014.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#015.src: Gravity's Monolith, they call it... an inescapable pull, drawing you deeper and deeper into its clutches the more you try to break free!
True Colours#015.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#016.src: Oh, you're one to talk about dramatics. But he's right. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
True Colours#016.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#017.src: Unfortunately, it would seem we also lack the details on who specifically has been sent there.
True Colours#017.speaker: Azael

True Colours#018.src: Sigh. Azael, sir, it's cruel to leave them in the dark. You need to tell them.
True Colours#018.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#020.src: I suppose you are right, captain. It is regarding the older woman among your party... Syndra, was it?
True Colours#020.speaker: Azael

True Colours#021.src: It would seem that Her Majesty has made her into a statement.
True Colours#021.speaker: Azael

True Colours#023.src: She was publicly executed during the festival, as a way to send a message.
True Colours#023.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#024.src: Subtle as a brick, aren't you?
True Colours#024.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#025.src: I apologize. This must be a shock. It is my understanding she was something of a leader to you all.
True Colours#025.speaker: Azael

True Colours#026.src: So it would seem. My, it has been an age since Her Majesty last performed such an act... how interesting, that she would deem it necessary.
True Colours#026.speaker: Azael

True Colours#027.src: But rest assured that her death will not be for nought. She fought like a true warrior, to the bitter end.
True Colours#027.speaker: Azael

True Colours#030.src: Yes, a fine idea, Cileon. Space - that we certainly can provide!
True Colours#030.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#031.src: Ugh. Fine. Captains, let's talk plans. Come on.
True Colours#031.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#032.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#034.src: I... I didn't think she could... how...?
True Colours#034.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#035.src: She... she d-died, and we... w-we all got separated. She died and... she's d-dead. D-dead dead... dead. She's... dead.
True Colours#035.speaker: Sui

True Colours#036.src: And the others... to Deraj? What... what are we going to do now?
True Colours#036.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#037.src: N-no, we... we can't. You... you heard Rurie. There's no escaping once they take you there...
True Colours#037.speaker: Sui

True Colours#038.src: I... I've lost too many people to th-that place. So many friends, c-captured and... and taken...
True Colours#038.speaker: Sui

True Colours#040.src: Player, are you really considering this?! You can't just- just- throw yourself into a suicide mission!
True Colours#040.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#041.src: ...fine. Fine! Just... make sure you c-come back. The three of us, we... we're all that's, ha, left.
True Colours#041.speaker: Sui

True Colours#043.src: I need to get back to work. Keep trying to align the resonances... maybe if I get it to work, it'll actually help us...
True Colours#043.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#044.src: ...Player, um. You should... tell Master Azael what you're doing. Before you... go.
True Colours#044.speaker: Sui

True Colours#045.src: Say good bye to Master Azael before heading to the Deraj Prison at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#046.src: Stupid... resonance core. Pink, green, blue, white, gold... what am I supposed to even do with this?!
True Colours#046.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#049.src: I must apologize once more for being so blunt with the news. I am often told I am lacking in that kind of sensitivity.
True Colours#049.speaker: Azael

True Colours#050.src: Worry not, that is what you have us captains for! In addition to all the, ah, other stuff we do!
True Colours#050.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#051.src: ... Say, are the other two... taking it well? I notice they haven't joined you.
True Colours#051.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#052.src: Pardon me? Did I hear that correctly? You did hear all I said about Gravity's Monolith, right? Inescapable pull... so on and so forth?
True Colours#052.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#053.src: Are you truly certain about this decision? Have you thought this through?
True Colours#053.speaker: Azael

True Colours#054.src: ... Well, if you truly wish to risk your life for a one in a million chance of a miracle, then who am I to interfere?
True Colours#054.speaker: Azael

True Colours#055.src: Ah, but might I? See, I have actually been plotting assorted plans for breaking in myself over the years! Though, of course, master Azael has always forbidden me from trying...
True Colours#055.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#057.src: Hmph! Good reason or not, the plots exist! Whether or not they are viable is anyone's guess... but nonetheless- would you allow me to join-
True Colours#057.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#058.src: Absolutely not. If they truly wish, the outsiders are permitted to throw their lives away. You, on the other hand, I cannot afford to lose.
True Colours#058.speaker: Azael

True Colours#059.src: Oh, you're no fun. Fine, fine, I will stay if I must. Well in that case, once you return, I will demand a full report on what it's like in there!
True Colours#059.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#060.src: What's the food like in there? How about entertainment? Perhaps even a dossier on that Warden, Oru? I can go on!
True Colours#060.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#061.src: Enough, Captain Rurie. Player, there is a bridge in the south-eastern corner of the {p} that crosses directly to the prison's entrance.
True Colours#061.speaker: Azael

True Colours#062.src: If you truly intend on seeing this through, stay on guard. The bridge is typically guarded by dozens of soldiers.
True Colours#062.speaker: Azael

True Colours#063.src: Good luck on your adventure, new friend! Just remember, no point in dying over this, eh? No shame in turning back if the going gets tough!
True Colours#063.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#065.src: Ah, a prison break... what a shame I cannot join. Is there anything more fun than such a daring mission?
True Colours#065.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#066.src: Captain Rurie, I still need you to fill out many information reports. You have five of them to catch up on already.
True Colours#066.speaker: Azael

True Colours#067.src: Oh, paperwork... My greatest nemesis. Well, if I must!
True Colours#067.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#068.src: Player. It's been... awhile since we've really had the chance to talk, hasn't it?
True Colours#068.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#069.src: They expected you might try the prison. I just... cleared out the guards temporarily. So we could have some privacy.
True Colours#069.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#070.src: You've probably heard as much already, but the prison isn't an option. Especially not from this side- there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#070.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#071.src: And even if you could get in... the Warden's not someone you want to mess with. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#071.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#072.src: I'd hope so! But being on different sides of this conflict makes that hard, doesn't it?
True Colours#072.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#073.src: And it's not like I'm the one who's been going on a killing spree through Fruma! I've heard what you did at {p}. Was that really necessary?
True Colours#073.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#074.src: Knock them out, then!! Use nonlethal force, if it's really necessary - I know you're capable of it!!
True Colours#074.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#075.src: And what do you mean by that?
True Colours#075.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#077.src: Yes! I have!! You're right, things are bad here in Fruma. I'm not blind to any of it. You of all people should know how deeply familiar I am with all the Crown has done!
True Colours#077.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#078.src: "Cursed..." Have you learned what it means by now? Horrible, uncontrollable power, so they say. None of them really believe it.
True Colours#078.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#079.src: Just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored. I hate it! But I still agreed to this voluntarily, and you want to know why?
True Colours#079.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#080.src: Because in this position, I can actually DO something about it! They've given me authority, and yes there are obligations attached, but I can CHANGE things!
True Colours#080.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#081.src: ...of course, it's not like I've had the chance! From the moment I recovered from... from ascension, all I've been hearing about is what you've been up to!!
True Colours#081.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#082.src: Fighting your way back into the province, and for what? For me?! I didn't ASK you to do that!
True Colours#082.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#083.src: And aiding a resistance group? I- ugh, okay, look, I get it. I actually do. They... they seem like nice people. They do.
True Colours#083.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#084.src: ...I just wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#084.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#085.src: I know! I know! But it was your side that instigated it!!
True Colours#085.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#086.src: And I did try to warn you! I didn't want that to happen, obviously! But... sigh. I didn't get to you quick enough.
True Colours#086.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#087.src: Look, I'm... I'm sorry. I wish nobody had to die. I wish a lot of things could have been handled differently.
True Colours#087.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#088.src: ...I've gotten off track. This isn't what I wanted to talk to you about at all.
True Colours#088.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#089.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for your group... you, specifically. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to... explain things.
True Colours#089.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#090.src: I... I guess so. I guess you've finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#090.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#091.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was... but that doesn't mean I have to like it.
True Colours#091.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#092.src: Look... you should hear her out.
True Colours#092.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#094.src: She's like us, you know? She was... forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn't escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#094.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#095.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom...
True Colours#095.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#096.src: She made Fruma, for herself, and- and yes! Yes, she's responsible for what happened to us! I know!! Trust me, I have not forgotten!!
True Colours#096.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#097.src: But... but it's so rare to find someone who understands. Who knows what it's like. Who- who forged her own path forward! If she could do it, then...
True Colours#097.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#099.src: I know you won't leave your friends. It's why I didn't bring the soldiers I was assigned... I was instructed to bring you in by force if you didn't come willingly, after all.
True Colours#099.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#100.src: I just... I need you to understand. Just as you have your reasons for what you've done, so do I.
True Colours#100.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#101.src: Sigh... You remember what she said, don't you? A ceaseless, meaningless war, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#101.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#102.src: Haven't you seen the symptoms, the consequences? Light and Dark and the War they leave in their wake?
True Colours#102.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#103.src: If one side wins, everything ends. Fruma, Wynn, Gavel- nothing will matter if they get what they want.
True Colours#103.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#104.src: That's... what the tournament was for. She wanted someone powerful, who was from Fruma, but who had also seen... all of it.
True Colours#104.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#107.src: I'll let you get back to your friends. I'll even take my soldiers and leave. This one last time, I'll... I'll let you go.
True Colours#107.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#108.src: I have another warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p}- Gikyo... they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They're preparing an attack.
True Colours#108.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#109.src: You should have more than enough time to warn everybody this time around. I- I know what happened with Syndra was... was awful, but...
True Colours#109.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#110.src: ...if Gikyo captures you, your friends will wish what happens to them was as quick as what Her Majesty did. Trust me.
True Colours#110.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#111.src: Now... go. Save the friends you have left. While you still can.
True Colours#111.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#112.src: Player. You've been busy haven't you?
True Colours#112.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#113.src: Not as much as you'd think. I've only just recovered enough to start doing things around here.
True Colours#113.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#114.src: Imagine my surprise when I found you were the one responsible for all the commotion. That you were even in Fruma in the first place!
True Colours#114.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#115.src: Sigh... look. They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#115.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#116.src: ...They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#116.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#117.src: Usually, at least. I've cleared them out temporarily, so that we could have some privacy.
True Colours#117.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#118.src: We didn't really get to talk back at the festival, after all. You... probably have questions.
True Colours#118.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#121.src: She mentioned it to you too, didn't she? That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#121.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#122.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
True Colours#122.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#123.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#123.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#124.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#124.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#125.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's-
True Colours#125.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#127.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#127.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#128.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#128.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#130.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#130.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#131.src: ...I am. I'm not sure how to feel about it still, honestly.
True Colours#131.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#132.src: There's... two parts to it. Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#132.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#133.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#133.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#134.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#134.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#135.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#135.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#136.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#136.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#139.src: It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
True Colours#139.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#140.src: It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
True Colours#140.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#141.src: And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
True Colours#141.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#142.src: ...I try not to use it unless I have to.
True Colours#142.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#144.src: She mentioned it to you too, didn't she?
True Colours#144.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#145.src: That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#145.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#146.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too and more.
True Colours#146.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#147.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#147.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#148.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#148.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#149.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's
True Colours#149.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#151.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#151.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#152.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#152.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#154.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#154.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#155.src: …sigh. I thought… I thought I had it all figured out, but you being here is making things harder than I’d like.
True Colours#155.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#156.src: Ha. Well… sort of, but not really. You’ve learned what it really means by now, then? Horrible, uncontrollable power… so they say.
True Colours#156.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#157.src: It's all paper-thin, in the end. It's just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored.
True Colours#157.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#158.src: ...and knowing that it was all manufactured, that there was never anything actually... wrong...
True Colours#158.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#159.src: To some extent, it's a relief but more than that it makes me angry. This was weighing on me for so long, and for it to mean... nothing, in the end?
True Colours#159.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#160.src: ...just another thing I want to change in Fruma. If I get the chance, that is.
True Colours#160.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#161.src: ...you being here is only making it harder for me to do anything about it of course.
True Colours#161.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#163.src: They didn’t want us here. We were… disposable soldiers, just a resource to keep Wynn standing.
True Colours#163.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#164.src: But now, all of a sudden… Now, they’ve changed their mind.
True Colours#164.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#165.src: But I can’t just… forget. I had my memories discarded, and was shipped off to Wynn, for something beyond my control.
True Colours#165.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#166.src: For something I’ve learned to appreciate over time. For something that was never really a curse!!
True Colours#166.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#168.src: I did some digging when I got here, you know? I went looking for anyone I might have known here, before……
True Colours#168.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#169.src: No one. Not a single person who knew me. Not a single person left to miss me, or even notice my absence!
True Colours#169.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#170.src: I had my self stripped away from me, and it doesn’t even matter! Because there was nothing here for me anyway!!
True Colours#170.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#172.src: I can’t imagine the same for Aledar. He must have had… someone.
True Colours#172.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#173.src: I guess it doesn’t matter. He’s gone anyway, isn’t he?
True Colours#173.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#174.src: Why? Because you've been causing the crown problems ever since you broke in.
True Colours#174.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#175.src: Nobody will listen to anything not related to you... and for good reason! You massacred a fort of soldiers, you've killed Sovereign Zhiraok twice now...
True Colours#175.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#177.src: Fine. You've killed Sovereign Zhiraok once, and... helped a second time...?
True Colours#177.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#178.src: ...okay. And that isn't to mention the plot to kill the Queen.
True Colours#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#179.src: I...ugh. I wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#179.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#180.src: I know. I know. I tried to warn you, to get you to call it off, but...sigh. It doesn't matter now. It's already done.
True Colours#180.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#181.src: ...I'm sorry about the rest of your friends. The Leaves in the Wind. They... they seem like nice people.
True Colours#181.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#183.src: I've gotten off track. I had something I needed to tell you.
True Colours#183.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#184.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for you. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to...explain things.
True Colours#184.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#185.src: I… I guess so. I guess you’ve finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#185.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#186.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was… but that doesn’t mean I have to like it.
True Colours#186.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#187.src: …I think you should hear her out, but that’s your choice to make. I just thought you should know.
True Colours#187.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#188.src: …okay. I can do that. Who first?
True Colours#188.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#189.src: ...me? I... I guess I'm one now, too. I'm still not sure how to feel about it, honestly. There's... two parts to it.
True Colours#189.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#190.src: Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#190.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#191.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#191.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#192.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#192.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#193.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#193.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#194.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#194.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#197.src: It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
True Colours#197.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#198.src: It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
True Colours#198.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#199.src: And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
True Colours#199.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#200.src: ...I try not to use it unless I have to.
True Colours#200.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#202.src: He’s… probably the best of them all. He does genuinely care about his district’s well-being I’ve seen the stuff he’s done over {~} years.
True Colours#202.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#203.src: When I was ascending… he was the only one who bothered telling me what to expect ahead of time.
True Colours#203.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#204.src: …he’s not perfect. Nobody in these positions of power is. But he’s the best Fruma has to offer.
True Colours#204.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#206.src: I still feel like I don’t entirely understand… I don’t know. Whatever it was she was working on which you stole, by the way it was important.
True Colours#206.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#207.src: …Zhiraok says she neglected her district, and left it on him to pick up the slack. Was that because of the project, or… did she just not care?
True Colours#207.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#208.src: I don’t know. And, now… she’s gone, either way.
True Colours#208.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#210.src: Eugh. He’s... frustrating. I mean we both saw him during that tournament, right? He really thinks he’s better than everyone else around him.
True Colours#210.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#211.src: What’s annoying is that he actually has the skill to back those claims up! There’s a reason he leads the military, after all. Apparently, he even taught himself magic!
True Colours#211.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#212.src: …truth be told, I’m not unfamiliar with dealing with this kind of person. You’ve seen Kymer. I just… wish it didn’t get to me as much as it does.
True Colours#212.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#215.src: I don’t know much about them. I’ve only met them a few times, but they’re… off-putting. I get the sense this is all just a game for them.
True Colours#215.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#216.src: …to tell you the truth… they scare me. I don’t think there’s a boundary they’re unwilling to cross, in order to achieve results.
True Colours#216.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#217.src: You might end up running into them while you’re here. If you do… be careful, alright?
True Colours#217.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#219.src: He’s… dangerous. I’ve only met him once, when I was ascending, but once was enough.
True Colours#219.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#220.src: In terms of sheer brute power, he has the most of any of the Sovereigns. You can feel it radiating off of him. He could crush you with barely a second thought, if he wanted.
True Colours#220.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#221.src: …luckily he stays at Gravity’s Monolith for the most part. He won’t be a problem if you just… stay away.
True Colours#221.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#222.src: I would recommend you stay away. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#222.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#225.src: There’s… nothing much to say. Not because I don’t want to, but because I just don’t know that much about her.
True Colours#225.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#226.src: She keeps her secrets to herself. I’ve only even spoken to her a few times, and all of it was about…
True Colours#226.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#229.src: It’s what I received the blessing for.
True Colours#229.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#230.src: I… don’t want to talk about it, right now. It won’t matter until all of this resolves, either way.
True Colours#230.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#233.src: She’s done awful, horrible things. All of Fruma’s problems trace themselves back to her, in some way.
True Colours#233.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#234.src: But… there’s more to her than that.
True Colours#234.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#235.src: She’s like us, you know? She was… forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn’t escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#235.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#236.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom…
True Colours#236.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#238.src: …it’s rare to find someone who understands, you know? Of course, I’ve had you, and… and Aledar, but it’s isolating. Even others from Fruma, they just… don’t get it.
True Colours#238.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#239.src: So to have found someone who knows what it’s like, who managed to forge her own path forward… that connection feels worth holding onto.
True Colours#239.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#241.src: I should be going. And… you should get back to your friends.
True Colours#241.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#242.src: Before I do… I have a warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p} Gikyo… they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They’re preparing an attack of some kind.
True Colours#242.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#243.src: …you should be able to warn everybody in time this time around. Make sure nobody gets captured. If they do… it- it won’t be pretty.
True Colours#243.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#244.src: Now… go. Save the friends you still have left with you.
True Colours#244.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#247.src: Player, you're... you're back. Does... does that mean you...?
True Colours#247.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#248.src: You're... you're alone. Where, um... where are they?
True Colours#248.speaker: Sui

True Colours#253.src: How do you know? H-how is it compromised?
True Colours#253.speaker: Sui

True Colours#254.src: That... did he really do the same thing twice?! Ugh, why is he even helping us?
True Colours#254.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#256.src: Hey hey, Sui and Yusanu! The creature has begun to speak! Isn't it a miracle?
True Colours#256.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#257.src: Oh, you return! That was... a rather quick excursion. Well, how was it then? Simple in-and-out break-in?
True Colours#257.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#258.src: Though I hadn't spotted any new arrivals, so... perhaps not.
True Colours#258.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#259.src: I see, I see. Ran into too many guards, I suppose? It may be for the best, in any case - we've ourselves a talking changeling!
True Colours#259.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#260.src: Now, as I was saying - you all should come and take a listen, it really is very-
True Colours#260.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#261.src: Oh dear! Why didn't you lead with that?! Goodness, that's a problem and a half... I'll have to inform Fuhue.
True Colours#261.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#262.src: She just so happens to be questioning the prisoner as we speak, in fact! The little lizard has happened to spill some... rather interesting secrets.
True Colours#262.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#263.src: Come along, kiddos! Let's give it a look, shall we?
True Colours#263.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#268.src: It's shut up now, but it was speaking just a moment ago. Don't worry, I'll be able to get it talking again.
True Colours#268.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#269.src: You'll want to hear what it says. It's relevant to your current concerns.
True Colours#269.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#270.src: Well alright, Fuhue, take it away!
True Colours#270.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#271.src: Hm! Seems to have done the trick.
True Colours#271.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#273.src: What? Magic? I don't know what that word means.
True Colours#273.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#274.src: They refer to curses or blessings, captain.
True Colours#274.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#275.src: Oh! No, no, certainly not. It's a simple talisman. They're a traditional art, passed down to us through generations of the Canopy.
True Colours#275.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#276.src: I believe Master Azael explained it to Yusanu the other day? By inscribing specific glyphs in certain patterns, they can be ignited for varying powerful effects.
True Colours#276.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#277.src: Through experimentation, we've determined which glyphs yield which results, though there's more we still don't know! As a matter of fact-
True Colours#277.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#278.src: Fuhue, I appreciate the enthusiasm, I do, but shouldn't we return to the matter at hand?
True Colours#278.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#279.src: Yes. Of course. That's enough on talismans for now. Everyone, hurry up and take a look.
True Colours#279.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#280.src: I am an ordinary citizen! This is a crime!
True Colours#280.speaker: Changeling

True Colours#282.src: Ah, I see now. This one hadn't made it very far in its training. That would explain why it was so easy to capture.
True Colours#282.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#287.src: It- it knows! It knows their names, so- so does it know where-
True Colours#287.speaker: Sui

True Colours#288.src: No mention of my brothers... or anyone else from the Steel Feather...
True Colours#288.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#289.src: Oh... I- I didn't even... realize. I didn't even think... I- I'm sorry.
True Colours#289.speaker: Sui

True Colours#290.src: It's... fine. I just... wish I could know for sure they're still alive out there.
True Colours#290.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#291.src: Hey, little man, lighten up! The way I see it, it's incredibly likely they've split the two groups.
True Colours#291.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#292.src: Yes. It's a very common psychological torture technique! Splitting up groups of people does a number on one's-
True Colours#292.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#293.src: Fuhue, really, do you think this is the time? Given our audience?
True Colours#293.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#295.src: Now, importantly, all changelings receive training here in the {p}! The crown has a special fort up on the eastern mountainside for it.
True Colours#295.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#296.src: Oh! Oh, we can organize a raid on the fort, gather information and find-
True Colours#296.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#297.src: News? What news? I haven't heard anything from the owls yet this morning, and...
True Colours#297.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#298.src: Did I forget? Forget what? Goodness, what am I missing...
True Colours#298.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#299.src: Oh! Oh, dear, right! Right right right! I remember now!
True Colours#299.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#300.src: The crown knows our location, huh?
True Colours#300.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#301.src: Again?! Gah!!! Barely get a month's rest before we have to move again...
True Colours#301.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#302.src: Ugh! I guess I'll go gather all our paperwork and emergency rations...
True Colours#302.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#303.src: I'll summon the owls and deploy them to begin evacuations. I'll have to track down Cileon as well...
True Colours#303.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#304.src: You know they're just going to stay behind to take out as many soldiers as possible, right?
True Colours#304.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#305.src: Cocky bastard... of course they will.
True Colours#305.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#306.src: Anyway! Kiddos, I'll meet you up at the top of this tree! That's where the Owls' headquarters are!
True Colours#306.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#307.src: Rurie, I can't deal with all this paperwork on my own! Hand me two of your workers.
True Colours#307.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#310.src: Ah! Of course. That'll do. Well, chop chop outsiders. Pack up here!
True Colours#310.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#312.src: Head to the meet up place at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#313.src: These talismans... the colors, pink green blue white gold... the shapes... there's something. There's something.
True Colours#313.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#314.src: I'm getting close, I can feel it. I just need... a little more time.
True Colours#314.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#315.src: They keep talking like we aren't here...
True Colours#315.speaker: Sui

True Colours#316.src: It's... it's okay. I know they're alive. There's hope! There's hope, there's hope, there's hope.
True Colours#316.speaker: Sui

True Colours#318.src: Ugh! I need to get to my lists. I can't think straight!
True Colours#318.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#319.src: Well, it's a good thing we have the emergency shelter! A shame it's in a cave. Sigh...
True Colours#319.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#322.src: Well well well well! And there they all are!
True Colours#322.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#323.src: Greetings are in order to the little doves! Ready to get moving then?
True Colours#323.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#325.src: Owls? Why, yes, of course - but you, dear friends, are doves. The small and defenseless, in dire need of aid...
True Colours#325.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#326.src: Captain, if we're all in order, shouldn't we get moving? We're to lead them to the next hideout.
True Colours#326.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#327.src: Right you are! Right you are, indeed. Then to the north we shall fly, little doves and silent owls!
True Colours#327.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#328.src: Meet up with Sui, Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#329.src: And so we fly forth, birds of the flock! Onwards we go!
True Colours#329.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#332.src: Oof! My goodness, they don't make these things quite like they used to! Since when have the ziplines been so... exhilerating?
True Colours#332.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#333.src: Not the most graceful landing, captain.
True Colours#333.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#334.src: Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
True Colours#334.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#335.src: Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
True Colours#335.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#336.src: ...Player, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
True Colours#336.speaker: Sui

True Colours#337.src: Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
True Colours#337.speaker: Sui

True Colours#338.src: Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
True Colours#338.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#339.src: Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
True Colours#339.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#340.src: You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
True Colours#340.speaker: Sui

True Colours#341.src: Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
True Colours#341.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#342.src: Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
True Colours#342.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#343.src: ...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
True Colours#343.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#344.src: And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
True Colours#344.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#345.src: Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
True Colours#345.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#346.src: Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
True Colours#346.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#347.src: So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
True Colours#347.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#348.src: Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
True Colours#348.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#349.src: Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
True Colours#349.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#350.src: And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
True Colours#350.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#351.src: ...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
True Colours#351.speaker: Sui

True Colours#352.src: I- we can't, keep putting all the work on Player's shoulders. We need a better plan!
True Colours#352.speaker: Sui

True Colours#353.src: Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
True Colours#353.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#357.src: A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
True Colours#357.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#358.src: Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
True Colours#358.speaker: Sui

True Colours#359.src: H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
True Colours#359.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#362.src: Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
True Colours#362.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#363.src: I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
True Colours#363.speaker: Sui

True Colours#364.src: B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
True Colours#364.speaker: Sui

True Colours#368.src: Those... those must have been changelings!
True Colours#368.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#369.src: Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
True Colours#369.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#370.src: Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
True Colours#370.speaker: Cileon

True Colours#371.src: Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
True Colours#371.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#372.src: Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
True Colours#372.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#373.src: Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
True Colours#373.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#374.src: What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger {p}, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
True Colours#374.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#375.src: To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
True Colours#375.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#376.src: But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
True Colours#376.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#377.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#379.src: Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
True Colours#379.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#380.src: Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
True Colours#380.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#381.src: Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
True Colours#381.speaker: Sui

True Colours#382.src: I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
True Colours#382.speaker: Sui

True Colours#383.src: But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
True Colours#383.speaker: Sui

True Colours#385.src: ...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
True Colours#385.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#386.src: I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
True Colours#386.speaker: Sui

True Colours#388.src: N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
True Colours#388.speaker: Sui

True Colours#389.src: Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
True Colours#389.speaker: Sui

True Colours#391.src: ...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
True Colours#391.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#392.src: Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
True Colours#392.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#393.src: Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
True Colours#393.speaker: Sui

True Colours#394.src: No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
True Colours#394.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#395.src: Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
True Colours#395.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#396.src: And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
True Colours#396.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#397.src: ...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
True Colours#397.speaker: Sui

True Colours#398.src: Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
True Colours#398.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#399.src: ...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
True Colours#399.speaker: Sui

True Colours#401.src: I- ha, I, I did it!!
True Colours#401.speaker: Sui

True Colours#402.src: That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
True Colours#402.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#403.src: It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
True Colours#403.speaker: Sui

True Colours#404.src: Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#405.src: L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
True Colours#405.speaker: Sui

True Colours#406.src: Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
True Colours#406.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#408.src: Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
True Colours#408.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#409.src: How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
True Colours#409.speaker: Sui

True Colours#410.src: What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
True Colours#410.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#411.src: Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
True Colours#411.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#412.src: Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
True Colours#412.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#414.src: Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
True Colours#414.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#415.src: THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
True Colours#415.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#416.src: Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
True Colours#416.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#417.src: Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
True Colours#417.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#418.src: Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
True Colours#418.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#419.src: And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and Player can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
True Colours#419.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#421.src: Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
True Colours#421.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#422.src: Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
True Colours#422.speaker: Sui

True Colours#423.src: Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#424.src: Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
True Colours#424.speaker: Sui

True Colours#427.src: I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
True Colours#427.speaker: Sui

True Colours#428.src: I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
True Colours#428.speaker: Sui

True Colours#429.src: Uh, I found this map... come here.
True Colours#429.speaker: Sui

True Colours#431.src: "{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
True Colours#431.speaker: Sui

True Colours#432.src: This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
True Colours#432.speaker: Sui

True Colours#434.src: And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
True Colours#434.speaker: Sui

True Colours#435.src: There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
True Colours#435.speaker: Sui

True Colours#436.src: ...th-thanks for being here, Player. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
True Colours#436.speaker: Sui

True Colours#437.src: Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#438.src: Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#439.src: Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!

True Colours#445.src: C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
True Colours#445.speaker: Sui

True Colours#447.src: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
True Colours#447.speaker: Sui

True Colours#448.src: It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
True Colours#448.speaker: Sui

True Colours#450.src: There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
True Colours#450.speaker: Sui

True Colours#451.src: How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, Player, they- they have to!!
True Colours#451.speaker: Sui

True Colours#452.src: Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
True Colours#452.speaker: Sui

True Colours#453.src: Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#456.src: Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
True Colours#456.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#457.src: No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
True Colours#457.speaker: Sui

True Colours#458.src: Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
True Colours#458.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#459.src: You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
True Colours#459.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#460.src: But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
True Colours#460.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#461.src: Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
True Colours#461.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#462.src: Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
True Colours#462.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#463.src: Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
True Colours#463.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#464.src: Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
True Colours#464.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#465.src: Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
True Colours#465.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#466.src: Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
True Colours#466.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#467.src: And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
True Colours#467.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#468.src: Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
True Colours#468.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#469.src: And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
True Colours#469.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#470.src: Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
True Colours#470.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#471.src: Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#472.src: Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#473.src: He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
True Colours#473.speaker: Sui

True Colours#476.src: He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
True Colours#476.speaker: Sui

True Colours#477.src: And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
True Colours#477.speaker: Sui

True Colours#480.src: No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
True Colours#480.speaker: Sui

True Colours#481.src: We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
True Colours#481.speaker: Sui

True Colours#482.src: I already GOT revenge, Player!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
True Colours#482.speaker: Sui

True Colours#483.src: He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
True Colours#483.speaker: Sui

True Colours#485.src: We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
True Colours#485.speaker: Sui

True Colours#487.src: ...this is all my fault, isn't it?
True Colours#487.speaker: Sui

True Colours#488.src: I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
True Colours#488.speaker: Sui

True Colours#489.src: I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
True Colours#489.speaker: Sui

True Colours#490.src: I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
True Colours#490.speaker: Sui

True Colours#491.src: I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
True Colours#491.speaker: Sui

True Colours#492.src: But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
True Colours#492.speaker: Sui

True Colours#494.src: Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. Player, Player, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
True Colours#494.speaker: Sui

True Colours#495.src: We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
True Colours#495.speaker: Sui

True Colours#496.src: ...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
True Colours#496.speaker: Sui

True Colours#497.src: Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#499.src: Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
True Colours#499.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#500.src: We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
True Colours#500.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#501.src: It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
True Colours#501.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#502.src: Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
True Colours#502.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#508.src: They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
True Colours#508.speaker: Sui

True Colours#509.src: The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
True Colours#509.speaker: Sui

True Colours#511.src: Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
True Colours#511.speaker: Sui

True Colours#512.src: So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
True Colours#512.speaker: Sui

True Colours#513.src: Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
True Colours#513.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#514.src: Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
True Colours#514.speaker: Sui

True Colours#515.src: At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
True Colours#515.speaker: Sui

True Colours#516.src: S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
True Colours#516.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#517.src: DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
True Colours#517.speaker: Sui

True Colours#518.src: Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
True Colours#518.speaker: Sui

True Colours#519.src: The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
True Colours#519.speaker: Sui

True Colours#521.src: And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
True Colours#521.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#522.src: Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
True Colours#522.speaker: Sui

True Colours#523.src: If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
True Colours#523.speaker: Sui

True Colours#524.src: Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
True Colours#524.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#525.src: Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
True Colours#525.speaker: Sui

True Colours#527.src: I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
True Colours#527.speaker: Sui

True Colours#528.src: YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
True Colours#528.speaker: Sui

True Colours#531.src: Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
True Colours#531.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#533.src: Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
True Colours#533.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#534.src: ...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
True Colours#534.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#536.src: Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
True Colours#536.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#537.src: Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
True Colours#537.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#538.src: A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
True Colours#538.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#539.src: But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
True Colours#539.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#540.src: And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
True Colours#540.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#541.src: ... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
True Colours#541.speaker: Sui

True Colours#542.src: Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
True Colours#542.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#543.src: If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
True Colours#543.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#544.src: Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
True Colours#544.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#545.src: ...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
True Colours#545.speaker: Sui
